title: Create: Skyward!
description: THE modpack for the best experience with Create: Aeronautics!
body:
![create skyward logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c3697316d8418cc67d3dd4dfe69f82cdc3955665.png)

This modpack is designed to make your Create: Aeronautics mod experience that much more enjoyable!

This pack offers:
- A lag free experience with sodium
- Create (for awesome technology additions!)
- Just enough items (for seamless recipe finding)
- Farmer's delight + addons for yummy food!
- a bunch of minigames to make exploration/mundane tasks more entertaining (Clavis/stardew fishing)
- And more!
